Q5779.reason: Saline and heparin lock flushes are most often ordered every 8 to 12 hours, and 8 hours is the interval most commonly cited in nursing references.

Q5227.reason: Under UCC 2-328(3), once the auctioneer calls for bids on an item sold without reserve, it cannot be withdrawn, so the woman's $100 bid can be enforced.

Q6156.reason: The company was represented at the deposition and had the opportunity to cross-examine, so the testimony is likely admissible as former testimony under FRE 804(b)(1), though the similar-motive requirement is debatable.
